response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates extensive software development experience and proven technical versatility, this candidate is fundamentally misaligned with the role's requirements. Most critically, native-level Japanese proficiency is an explicit requirement and is completely absent from the resume. Additionally, his 15+ year career trajectory focuses on web and full-stack development, not embedded systems security; his embedded systems experience is limited to a brief 6-month contract over a decade ago. The role requires deep expertise in security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption), networking protocols, Linux kernel development, and embedded firmware—none of which are evident in his background. His technical strengths lie in web infrastructure and application development, not the embedded networking security domain this position targets.
strengths: Extensive 15+ years of software development experience with demonstrated ability to learn and work across multiple languages and technical domains
Strong background in software engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, system design, and DevOps indicating professional software craftsmanship
Fluent English communication skills and proven ability to work internationally on diverse technical projects
concerns: No native-level Japanese language proficiency listed; only English (Fluent), Romanian (Fluent), and German (Basic) are mentioned—this is a stated requirement
Career heavily focused on web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, web frameworks) with only minimal and dated embedded systems experience; no recent embedded security work

No demonstrated expertise in required security technologies (encryption, authentication systems, attack detection), networking protocols (Layer 2/3, SNMP, NETCONF), or Linux kernel investigation and modification

key_factors.factor: Wrong technical domain (web vs. embedded security)
General software engineering competence and learning ability
